summary.text: Trent Ashby is a Republican state representative from Texas House District 9 who is running for Texas State Senate District 3 in the November 3, 2026 general election. An executive by profession, he has served in the Texas House since the early 2010s.

paragraphs.text: Trent Ashby was born in Rusk County, Texas, and lives in Lufkin, according to Ballotpedia.
He graduated from Henderson High School and earned a bachelor's degree in agricultural economics from Texas A&M University in 1996.
His career experience includes work as a legislative aide in the U.S. House of Representatives, as president and CEO of the Texas Forest Country Partnership, and as president of Community Title Co.
Ballotpedia lists Ashby's tenure in the Texas House of Representatives as beginning in 2013, and he currently represents District 9.
In 2023-2024 he was assigned to the House Transportation Committee.
He advanced from the Republican primary for Texas State Senate District 3 on March 3, 2026.
